cues: Irony: a mansion with bars to keep angels out, built with angel money.
Satire on authority: the Church asks whether he has a navel.
Simile: the patience of a dog who had no illusions.
And an open ending: he becomes an imaginary dot on the horizon, and we never learn what he was.
